Senses.Explanation: No warmth through three winters is the hermit’s condemned cold response in the old-woman-burns-the-hut case. After the woman’s physical test he gives this line; she condemns him and burns the hut. Repeated retellings preserve one event; later masters independently raise its dead, unresponsive coldness.
